# Security Policy

The Compose Call Guard team takes the security and privacy of our users seriously.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please do **NOT** open a public issue. Publicly disclosing a vulnerability can put user privacy at risk.

Instead, please report security concerns privately through one of the following methods:
1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting**: Go to the **Security** tab of this repository and click **Report a vulnerability**.
2. **Direct Security Contact**: Email the maintainer at `me@andrewwangdev.com` with the subject `[SECURITY] Compose Call Guard Vulnerability Report`.

### What to Include in Your Report
- A detailed description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept (PoC) code.
- Impact assessment (e.g., call log leakage, bypass of blocking rules).

### Response SLA & Timeline
We will make every reasonable effort to review, acknowledge, and investigate your report as promptly as feasible.

> [!NOTE]
> Because this repository is in a completed and archived state, no guaranteed response timeline or fixed SLA (such as 24 or 48 hours) is committed. Confirmed critical vulnerabilities will be addressed with high priority.
